title: Not a Fool: Complete the Underpromotion Fork
summary: After the checking knight promotion, collect the queen before giving Black another chance.

nodes.question: Black has moved the king to b7. What was the underpromotion for?
nodes.explanation: The knight on c8 attacks e7. The earlier rook offer, queen sacrifice and capture-promotion have already happened; this complete seven-piece diagram is the checked starting point.

branches.title: Source finish: take the queen
commentary: Begin after ...Kb7 at 52 seconds. White has Kh1, Nc8, g2 and h3 versus Kb7, Qe7 and Bg3.

Nxe7 completes the knight fork by taking the queen. White has a checked winning knight-and-two-pawn ending against a bishop. Black still has legal king and bishop moves, so the source’s final material gain is not described as a complete conversion.

branches.title: Independent error: check instead of collecting
commentary: An independently selected comparison tests giving one more knight check before taking the queen.
Nd6+ checks Kb7 but gives up the winning capture on e7. White changes a forced win into a forced loss.
Qxd6 removes the checking knight. The queen survives, and Black retains a checked win against White’s king and two pawns. Completing the fork mattered more than extending the sequence of checks.

exercises.prompt: Why does the knight promotion matter to this final position?
exercises.answer: A knight on c8 attacks e7 and checked Ka7 before the king moved. Its next task is Nxe7; this lesson verifies the later fork, without claiming to have solved the larger starting setup.

exercises.prompt: Why is Nd6+ a mistake even though it checks?
exercises.answer: The queen on e7 can capture the knight on d6. White must take that queen while the opportunity exists.

startContext: Begin after ...Kb7 at 52 seconds in the complete seven-piece position following the knight capture-promotion on c8. The larger rook sacrifice and Qxa7+/Kxa7 sequence remain source context outside exact verification. Nxe7 is the source finish; the extra-check error is an independently selected representative alternative.
verification_scope: Saved board images reviewed manually. Every encoded intermediate position and endpoint is checked against the tablebase. Selected instructive variations, not an exhaustive tree of all legal defenses.
